title: Don't Inoculate Everything: Stratified Inoculation Prompting Narrows Backdoor Triggers and Preserves Desired Traits
abstract: arXiv:2609.35356v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning can teach language models undesired behaviours alongside desired ones. Inoculation prompting (IP) aims to limit unwanted generalisation by requesting the undesired behaviour during training and removing the request at inference. However, undesired behaviour can still appear under unrelated prompts. IP can also hinder learning of the desired behaviour. We address these limitations in settings where both behaviours co-occur in most training examples, so filtering out examples with undesired behaviour leaves only a small clean subset. We introduce stratified inoculation prompting (SIP). SIP leverages a small clean subset to demonstrate that desired behaviour should persist without the undesired one across different contexts. SIP oversamples these clean examples under diverse non-eliciting prompts while inoculating the rest. SIP substantially reduces expression of undesired behaviour while preserving more of the de

translated_title: 切勿一律接种：分层接种提示收窄后门触发并保留期望特性
translated_abstract: 监督微调可能让语言模型在学习期望行为的同时学到不期望的行为。接种提示旨在通过在训练期间要求模型表现出不期望的行为、并在推理时移除该要求，来限制这种不期望行为的泛化。然而，在与之无关的提示下，不期望的行为仍可能出现；此外，接种提示还可能妨碍期望行为的学习。我们针对期望与不期望行为在大多数训练样本中同时出现的场景来解决这些局限，因为在这些场景下，若过滤掉含有不期望行为的样本，只会剩下很小的干净子集。我们提出了分层接种提示（SIP）。SIP 利用这个小的干净子集，向模型示范期望行为应在不同上下文中、在不伴随不期望行为的情况下持续存在。SIP 在多样化的非诱发式提示下对这些干净样本进行过采样，同时对其余样本进行接种。SIP 大幅降低了不期望行为的出现，同时保留了更多期望行为。
tldr: 提出分层接种提示（SIP）：对少量干净样本在多样化非诱发提示下过采样、对其余样本进行接种，从而显著抑制不期望行为并收窄后门触发范围，同时更好地保留期望特性。
en_tdlr: Stratified Inoculation Prompting (SIP) oversamples a small clean subset under diverse non-eliciting prompts while inoculating the rest, substantially reducing undesired behaviour and narrowing backdoor triggers while preserving desired traits.
